code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    solid = [(i, row[0]) for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_color = min((c for _, c in solid), key=lambda c: counts[c])
    sep = next(i for i, c in solid if c == sep_color)
    top = grid[:sep]
    bottom = grid[sep+1:]
    bg = Counter(v for row in top for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if a == bg and b == bg else bg for a, b in zip(top_row, bottom_row)]
            for top_row, bottom_row in zip(top, bottom)]
'''
